description: This source file defines structures, functions, and methods for constructing and configuring requests related to AI model completions, including message handling, request options, and response formatting.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a chat message with role and content.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for an AI completion request, including messages, model, temperature, max tokens, streaming, and response format.

classes.name: ResponseFormat
classes.description: Specifies the desired output format, either JSON object or JSON schema.

classes.name: JSONSchema
classes.description: Defines the schema for structured outputs, including name, strictness, and schema details.

methods.name: WithSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the request's message list.

methods.name: WithModel
methods.description: Overrides the default model used for the request.

methods.name: WithAPIKey
methods.description: Overrides the client's configured API key for this specific request.

methods.name: WithTemperature
methods.description: Sets the temperature parameter for the request.

methods.name: WithMaxTokens
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of tokens to generate.

methods.name: WithJSONMode
methods.description: Configures the response format to JSON object (non-strict).

methods.name: WithSchema
methods.description: Enables structured output with a specified JSON schema. Accepts structs, JSON byte slices, or raw JSON strings, converting structs to schemas.

methods.name: structToJSONSchema
methods.description: Converts a Go struct to a JSON schema object.

methods.name: goTypeToJSONType
methods.description: Maps Go types to corresponding JSON schema types.
